about_the_game:
Due to the feedback received for the base game, we hired humans and redraw all graphics instead of using AI.

This DLC replaces every AI asset with state-of-the-art human-crafted graphics.

Humanity strikes back from this moment on.

content_descriptors.notes: There is some hentai and gratuitous violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows Vista®
  • Processor: Dual core processor 2.6 GHz Intel® Pentium® D or AMD Athlon™ 64 X2 3800+ (Intel Core® 2 Duo 2.2 GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 4400+ or better recommended)
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 256 MB DirectX® 10.0-compliant video card or DirectX 9.0-compliant card with Shader Model 3.0 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Sound Card: Yes
  • VR Support: VR is currently NOT supported
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard, mouse & patience required

short_description: No more AI generated content! This DLC replaces every AI asset with state-of-the-art human-crafted graphics. Mankind's fightback begins now.
